definitions.explanation: The on'yomi reading of the kanji {乳|にゅう}, used almost exclusively in compounds referring to milk products or the mammary glands. The standalone kun'yomi form is ちち.

examples.japanese: {牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}を{毎日|まいにち}{飲|の}んでいる。
{母乳|ぼにゅう}で{赤|あか}ちゃんを{育|そだ}てている。
examples.english: She is raising the baby on breast milk.

examples.japanese: {乳製品|にゅうせいひん}にアレルギーがあるので{気|き}をつけている。
examples.english: I'm careful because I have an allergy to dairy products.

notes:
Almost never used alone in modern Japanese — appears in compounds. For the standalone Japanese word for 'milk' or 'breast', use ちち (also written {乳|ちち}).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}: cow's milk
- {母乳|ぼにゅう}: breast milk
- {豆乳|とうにゅう}: soy milk
- {乳製品|にゅうせいひん}: dairy products
- {乳児|にゅうじ}: infant; nursing baby
- {乳酸|にゅうさん}: lactic acid
